description: Create ONE COMPLETE ORIGINAL RUNE SENTINEL MALE BASE OUTFIT SPRITESHEET in ONE generation using ALL full reference sheets together. Output192x256 transparent PNG: 3 columns of64px cells (idle0,walk1,walk2), 4 rows (NORTH/back,EAST/right,SOUTH/front,WEST/left). Native roughly32px Tibia humans, original lower-right cell placement from Citizen. All12 sprites are the SAME new premium rune-order elite guard, drawn together, not12 costume variants. Invent a complete coherent wardrobe: fitted open-face steel helmet/angular brow, solid crafted breastplate with ONE inset diamond runestone in a stepped frame, strong belt/two short overlapping hip plates, fitted bracers, plain shoulder caps, dark tailored undergarment, paired knee plates/full greaves and armored boots. Exclusive sculpted metal across the WHOLE body, not Citizen recolored or covered in wrinkles. Broad readable metal planes, clear cloth joints, subtle angular craftsmanship; no speckled/checkerboard noise. Chest stone stays on FRONT, foreshortened/occluded in profiles, absent on back. Same component shapes, paired coverage, lengths and attachments in EVERY facing/walk phase, with perspective, occlusion and upper-left lighting. Learn actual classic Tibia art style from the COMPLETE Knight/Nightmare/Brotherhood sheets, how armor turns and moves. Their LEFT half is base, RIGHT half shows addons: output BASE ONLY with its own complete valuable design; head crest/ornate enlarged shoulders are later addons. Preserve Citizen's corresponding anatomy, face/hands, head/limb proportions, arm/leg bends and foot poses in ALL12 slots. Pixel art at native scale, no downsampling or oversized illustration. NEUTRAL white/silver/gray/charcoal clothing with natural skin tones. Transparent background. No copied outfit, extra limb, banner, weapons, shield, cape, addon spikes/crest, particles, labels, borders or text.

reference_images.name: Citizen
reference_images.usage: COMPLETE 12-FRAME ANATOMY/MOTION TEMPLATE. 3 columns=idle0/walk1/walk2; 4 rows=NORTH/EAST/SOUTH/WEST. Native64px cells, roughly32px figure at lower-right. Preserve corresponding head, face, hands, arm/leg/foot placements, proportions and gait. Fully redesign the clothing.

reference_images.name: Knight
reference_images.usage: COMPLETE KNIGHT SHEETS: LEFT half=12 base frames; RIGHT half=12 all-addon frames. Both contain ALL4 facings and ALL3 phases. Study classic Tibia armor, clean pixel planes and corresponding equipment through turning/walking. Do not copy design; weapons/addon ornaments are reference only.

reference_images.name: Nightmare
reference_images.usage: COMPLETE NIGHTMARE SHEETS: base12 LEFT, all-addons12 RIGHT, all directions/phases. Study premium whole-body plate construction and consistent helmet, waist and greaves across all frames. Do not copy it or include its shield/weapons/addon parts.

reference_images.name: Brotherhood
reference_images.usage: COMPLETE BROTHERHOOD SHEETS: base12 LEFT, all-addons12 RIGHT, all directions/phases. Study exclusive whole-garment identity, layering, clear silhouettes and consistent clothing construction. Not a direct-copy design or a new anatomy template.

workflow: A fresh complete twelve-frame outfit generated jointly from four entire native reference sheets. No rejected Rune Sentinel image, south-view anchor or per-direction generation.
artwork_policy: PixelLab generative AI draws the entire new sheet. Preserve original returned PNG. Only exact crops, previews and editable project packaging; do not hand-paint artwork or silently repair failed poses.
